note: The authoritative list of semantic pairs a candidate card must cover for its palette to verify against WCAG 2.2. A pair below its target is a violation in the ColorProof — the verdict blocks until it passes or routes to make-palette. Focus-ring pairs are deliberately ABSENT: focus-ring contrast is owned by check-focus (both skills' NOT clauses name that boundary) — route --focus-ring pairs there; never re-add them here.
mapping: A repo may ship its own role→pair manifest mapping these semantic roles onto its concrete token names (e.g. --a-fg-muted → --on-surface-muted). This file is the default role set, not a token spelling; the card's fgToken/bgToken fields carry the repo-side provenance.

pairs.note: any intent color bound as TEXT INK (inline error copy, danger links, validation messages) is normalText 4.5 — the shakedown's live miss: danger bound as text ink while typed only uiComponent 3.0
borders bounding interactive elements must clear 3:1
accent as NON-TEXT indication — chip fill, icon, selected-state tint (as text ink it is the 4.5 pair above)
intent as non-text indication (icon, badge fill)

escalation.rule: a pair below its target is a violation; the DecompositionGap it emits carries this prescription for make-palette to execute, in order: (1) step the FG one ramp step further from the BG's luminance, (2) step the BG one ramp step further, (3) redesign the ramp — a failing pair is never silently shipped
